This sorghum plot is small, and I have to be careful with money, but because I am in the North West and sorghum does better with some fertilizer, I will use a modest amount. I will mostly rely on my household's labor and some manure, and I will keep using local seed since improved seed is harder for me to justify on such a small intercropped plot. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide or herbicide this season.
